payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image visibly fulfill the request to turn the image into a drawing made from chalk?
node.criteria: Mark complete only when s2 passes, establishing a convincing whole-image chalk-drawing appearance. Mark partial when s1 passes but s2 fails, indicating genuine requested progress without convincing fulfillment. Mark absent only when s1 fails with sufficient evidence of no requested progress. Mark unknown when necessary evidence is unknown or insufficient; do not convert uncertainty into absence or completion.
node.binding: Target: The image is rendered as a drawing made from chalk, rather than merely showing an unrelated edit or a partial chalk effect.. Reference: The input image and the edited image; compare whether the edited image has the appearance of a chalk-made drawing..

outcome.description: Transform the image into a chalk drawing.
outcome.target: The image is rendered as a drawing made from chalk, rather than merely showing an unrelated edit or a partial chalk effect.
outcome.reference: The input image and the edited image; compare whether the edited image has the appearance of a chalk-made drawing.

dependencies.evidence: Compared with the source photograph, the edit has a clear hand-rendered, sketch-like appearance: outlines are drawn and softened, and the landscape and giraffes have visibly stylized shading. This is genuine progress toward a chalk drawing, though the image retains photographic-like detail and does not establish complete chalk-medium fulfillment.

The image has a chalky, grainy treatment and softened outlines, but the giraffes retain photographic detail and the scene reads mainly as a blurred photograph with an overlay rather than convincingly as a chalk drawing.
